title: feat(spec,formula): a formula field declares a currency result — returnType 'currency' with its own currencyConfig; inferFormulaReturn stamps it when provably money
body:
Fixes #22727

Clause-②: yes (widening)

Parked on #22744: the merge queue is walled for every lane. `render-projection-diff`'s base archive lacks the generated `registry.ts` since #22706, so `Type Check · source gates` fails on every merge-group run based at or after `ed1de8c2db`. This PR's own head `1e9d5ba927` is green, and it is re-queued once #22744 lands.

## What changed

- **`@objectstack/spec`: a formula declares a currency result.** `FieldSchema.returnType` is `number | text | boolean | date | currency`. A `currency` result carries its currency the way a currency field does: in the formula's OWN `currencyConfig`, the same `CurrencyConfigSchema`, the same defaults (absent means dynamic, the tenant default currency) and the same refusals (the `precision` tombstone, the three-character code, the `currencyMode` enum). One shape, not a second one.
- **Every exhaustive reader of a formula's `returnType` answers `currency` by name**, never by falling into a default arm (census below).
- **Both designer forms move with the enum.** `field.form.ts` and `object.form.ts` offer Currency (same list, same order, which `form-return-type-options.test.ts` derives from the enum). The field designer's Currency Config row now shows for a formula whose return type is Currency (`visibleWhen` widened with `data.returnType == 'currency'`). Help text and the four locale bundles regenerated or re-translated (`en` regenerated; `zh-CN` / `ja-JP` / `es-ES` re-translated by hand for the two changed help texts).
- **`@objectstack/formula`: `inferFormulaReturn(expression, fields)`**, the producer behind "authoring stamps it when the inferred type is provably money". It takes the host object's declared field map and returns the declaration to stamp: `{ returnType: 'currency' }`, plus `currencyConfig: { currencyMode: 'fixed', defaultCurrency }` when the source amounts share one fixed currency. Everything it cannot prove to be money answers exactly what `inferExpressionType` answers, which is unchanged.
- Hand-written docs (`formulas.mdx`, `field-types.mdx`, `validation-rules.mdx`) list the new member.

## Decision: "taken from the source field" is an authoring-time stamp, not a read-time derivation

Measured first: `currencyConfig` is ALREADY admitted on a `formula` field today (a full `FieldSchema` parse of a formula carrying `currencyConfig: { currencyMode: 'fixed', defaultCurrency: 'USD' }` succeeds and keeps it; it is equally admitted, and unread, on a `text` field). So "the field's own config" is an existing key gaining a reader, not a new admission. "From the source field" is realized by `inferFormulaReturn` copying the source currency into that declaration at authoring time. Nothing reads a referenced field's currency at display time.

- **Real business need.** HotCRM finding B-15 (formulas over money render as bare numbers). In this repo the two example money formulas — app-crm `opportunity.expected_revenue` and app-showcase `project.budget_remaining` — are both proven money by the new inference (pinned in `formula-return.test.ts`).
- **Long-term soundness.** Contract-first: the currency is a declaration the save door checks with the currency field's own schema. A read-time fallback from a formula to "some referenced field" is a consumer-side `??` (AGENTS.md Prime Directive 12): unchecked, and two consumers could pick two different sources.
- **Harder for AI to get wrong.** The declaration is visible and refused loudly when malformed; the producer never claims money it cannot prove (two different currencies, money times money, money plus a plain quantity, an unreadable source currency, a roll-up whose unit is not on this object), and in every such case falls through to today's answer. The stamped pair is complete — an absent member means "clear it", so a formula edited from money to a count loses its stale currency.
- **Startup focus.** Currency only: no `percent` or `datetime` member. No new gate, no new refusal (a `currencyConfig` on a non-currency formula stays admitted-and-unread, exactly as on every other non-currency type). No MCP surface change.

## Where the stamp lives (mechanism assumption 3, measured)

- The act of writing `returnType` lives only in objectui's designer: `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.tsx:1103-1108`, fed by `celAuthoring.ts:614-627`, which calls `@objectstack/formula`'s `inferExpressionType` and coerces any value outside its local `CEL_VALUE_TYPES` (`:600-602`) to `unknown`. Not edited here (follow-up named in the report).
- The inference it reads is in this repo, so the producer half — `inferFormulaReturn` — lands here.
- `@objectstack/mcp`'s `validate_expression` reports `inferredType` from `inferExpressionType` (unchanged, still never `currency`); its `describeObject` projection carries no `currencyConfig`, so it could not name the currency anyway. Noted below, not changed.

## Reader census

Instrument: `git grep -n "returnType"` over `packages/**` (non-test, non-dist), control: it hits the known reader `filter-boolean-comparand-declared-type.ts:318`.

| reader | answer for a `currency` formula |
|:---|:---|
| `FORMULA_RETURN_TYPE_AS_FIELD_TYPE` (`filter-text-operator-declared-type.ts`), shared by the text, number and boolean doors | `currency` → judged as the `currency` field: text operator refused (`INVALID_FILTER`), number door `judged`, boolean door `not-judged` — each pinned |
| door fixtures (`NUMBER_COMPARAND_DOOR_FIXTURE_FIELDS`, `TEXT_OPERATOR_DOOR_FIXTURE_FIELDS`) | gain `f_formula_currency`; their `returnType` type is now derived from `Field['returnType']` instead of a four-literal union |
| `display-name.ts` `isTitleEligible` | not title-eligible (only `text` is) — comment updated |
| `aggregate-field-type-compatibility.ts` | `formula` refused for sum/avg/min/max whatever it returns — unchanged |
| `ui/component.zod.ts` inline form field `returnType` (by reference) | widened with the enum; describe updated |
| `service-analytics` `native-sql-strategy.ts` / `measure-result-type.ts` | a formula reaches with no `returnType` and is deferred; the `formula-return-type-measure` walk now holds `currency` to the same `undefined` |
| objectql doors, plugin-security RLS compiler | relay the string to the spec verdicts above; no table of their own |

## Tests

Package tests on `20d64a3102`; the merge commit after it (`de9f741f33`) brought only `packages/cloud-connection` and its changeset from main.

- `@objectstack/spec`: `vitest run --project local` — 643 files, 19205 passed, 1 todo. New `formula-currency-result.test.ts` (a currency formula parses; its `currencyConfig` parses identically to a currency field's and is refused with identical code, path and message; CONTROL `number` unchanged; the enum is exactly the five). `form-return-type-options.test.ts` moved with the enum: `currency` offered by both forms and parses; `datetime` still refused and unoffered.
- `@objectstack/formula`: 47 files, 1326 passed. New `formula-return.test.ts`, 11 cases — the card's two pins (a formula over a currency field declares the currency result; CONTROL: a numeric formula stays `number`), the two example-app formulas, every non-money case asserted equal to the plain `inferExpressionType` answer, and every stamped declaration parsed by the rebuilt spec `FieldSchema`.
- `@objectstack/objectql` door suites (3 files, 93 passed), `@objectstack/service-analytics` `formula-return-type-measure` (10 passed), `@objectstack/platform-objects` (69 files, 1082 passed).
- Typecheck: spec, formula, platform-objects, service-analytics, objectql — all exit 0.

## Gates

- **Derived union, run at `de9f741f33`.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 120 families (the same set it derived at `20d64a3102`). All 120 ran at `de9f741f33` and every one exited 0; the `--ran` reconciliation over the recorded exit codes reads "120 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 120 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)". The set includes `check:generated`, `check:docs`, `check:api-surface`, `check:authorable-surface`, `check:adr-0087-registration` (a widening carries no disposition marker; green), `check:changeset-no-major`, `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-stale-fill`, `check:skills-token-ratchet`, `check:skill-examples`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:type-check-coverage`, `check:type-check-debt` and `check:nul-bytes`.
- **First round, for the record.** At `20d64a3102` two gates answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3, nothing measured): `check:skill-examples` (client-react unbuilt) and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (nine package dists absent). Both re-ran green after the builds, and the second round above measured them green directly.
- **Generated artifacts.** `check:generated` named one stale artifact after the enum moved, `content/docs/references/**`, regenerated with `gen:docs`; `authorable-surface` and `api-surface` did not move (an enum member is not a key, and no spec export was added).
- **Lint, narrowed (CI owns the repo-wide `pnpm lint`).** Population: the 20 lintable files in this diff against the merge base, all under `eslint.config.mjs`'s global `files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx,mts,cts,js,jsx,mjs,cjs}']` object; `--no-inline-config --format json` counted 20 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings. Invariance: the config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, stated in its own header at lines 327-328), so this diff cannot move a verdict on a file it does not touch.

## Governed surface

The skill line `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md:253` ('(no 'currency')') goes false when this lands. The seat carries it to the skills lane as a card blocked on #22727.

## Acceptance notes

- **The renderer is the next half.** objectui at the `.objectui-sha` pin draws an undeclared `returnType` through the text face (`packages/fields/src/widgets/FormulaField.tsx` final branch, `packages/fields/src/index.tsx:2703-2704` cell), so a formula hand-declared `currency` renders as monospace text until objectui formats it. The card names that follow-up (filed beside it, on hold until a spec release carries the member). Nothing in this repo stamps `currency` automatically, and the docs here state the declaration, not a display.
- **The designer stamp** (objectui `ObjectFieldInspector.tsx:1103-1108`, `celAuthoring.ts:600-627`) must call `inferFormulaReturn(source, draft.fields)` and write both members; until then it keeps stamping `number` for a money formula, as today.
- **`validate_expression` (MCP)** keeps answering `inferredType` from `inferExpressionType`; reporting a currency would need `describeObject` (`packages/mcp/src/stdio-data-bridge.ts:662-680`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts:553`) to project `currencyConfig`. Not changed: no measured pull, and the answer it gives (`number`) is still honoured.
- **`currencyConfig` on a formula whose `returnType` is not `currency`** is admitted and unread, as on every non-currency type (`FieldSchema` accepts each per-type key on any type; the forms gate visibility). No refusal added: it would be a narrowing and a new gate.
- The docs' "Financial Calculations" examples still declare money formulas `number`; moving them to `currency` belongs with the objectui rendering.
- `object.form.ts` was a stop boundary while #22713 was in flight; #22713 merged at 2026-10-10T20:27:42Z, `origin/main` was merged first, and only this file's `returnType` row moved.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

### 改了什么
公式字段现在可以声明"货币"结果:`returnType` 新增 `currency`,货币写在公式自己的 `currencyConfig` 里,与货币字段同一套结构和默认值(不写即 dynamic,用租户默认货币)。新增 `inferFormulaReturn`:作者编辑公式时,能证明结果是钱的就给出 `currency` 和源字段的货币,证明不了就和以前一样。两个设计器表单都提供"货币"选项。

### 为什么改
HotCRM 实测:引用金额字段的公式只能显示成裸数字。货币作为公式自身的声明,在保存时用货币字段同一套规则校验,不在渲染端回退去猜源字段。

### 风险与代价(含回滚)
纯加宽,以前合法的都仍合法。objectui 跟进之前,手工声明 `currency` 的公式会以文本样式显示(比数字样式差),所以本 PR 不自动给任何现有公式盖章。回滚:还原本 PR 即可,没有数据迁移。

### 席位意见


### 你要做的
本 PR 不改 `skills/**`,不触及受管面。那一行 skill 注释由席位另立 skills 卡(阻塞于 #22727),单独请你审。
